name: PDQ Connect
description: PDQ Connect lets you search your managed devices, device groups, and package library directly from Claude. Ask which machines missed a check-in, find devices that match specific hardware or OS criteria, look up available package versions, and kick off deployments to individual devices or groups, all in plain language. Built for IT admins who want to move fast without switching tabs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PDQ Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PDQ Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.pdq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PDQ Connect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDQ Connect provides these MCP tools: create_automation, create_deployment, create_group, get_vulnerability_details, search_automations, search_deployments, search_device_vulnerabilities, search_devices, search_groups, search_packages, search_top_vulnerable_devices, and search_vulnerabilities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PDQ Connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PDQ Connect in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does PDQ Connect MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDQ Connect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PDQ Connect is developed by PDQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
